name: DHL Singapore (DHL Group)

scam_info.sample: Official DHL communication is always sent from @dhl.com and subdomains (e.g. @del.dhl.com or @express.dhl.com), @dpdhl.com, @dhl-news.com, addresses with country domains after @dhl (e.g. @dhl.de, @dhl.fr, @dhl.ae)
scam_info.notes: SG version of DHL global 'Fraud Awareness' page: official sender domains and link domains (dhl.com, dpdhl.com, group.dhl.com, del.dhl.com, dhl-news.com or a country/campaign website); fraudulent SMS / social / WhatsApp / recruitment indicators (narrative); report to phishing@dhl.com. No SG-specific fake indicators; undated.

scam_info.sample: Always Access Our Official Websites and Tools at the Following Secure Domains: DHL Main Site: https://www.dhl.com/sg-en/home.html DHL Express Site and MyDHL+ Tool: https://mydhl.express.dhl/sg/en/home.html
scam_info.notes: SG-specific 'Phishing Site & Scam Call Advisory for Customers' (15 March 2025, DHL Express Singapore resource centre /discover/en-sg): lists official SG URLs (dhl.com/sg-en, mydhl.express.dhl/sg/en, dhl.com/discover/en-sg, delivery.dhl.com, shipnow.dhl.com/sg/en, mygts.dhl.com); 'DHL employees will never ask you for your account login details or OTPs'. 'url' = official URLs. Found via web search.

notes: SG pages under dhl.com/sg-en (entity_id dhl.com, global brand). All official_domains (a) from the fraud-awareness page ('We never link to a website other than our own starting with ... https://dhl.com/, https://dpdhl.com/, https://group.dhl.com/, https://del.dhl.com/, https://dhl-news.com/'; email domains incl. country domains @dhl.de/@dhl.fr/@dhl.ae - only dhl.de added as example). Page had to be found by known footer path (linked from every dhl.com footer). express.dhl is a registrable domain under the .dhl brand TLD ((a) mydhl.express.dhl listed as official on the SG phishing advisory).
